subject: STABLE api-surface-sonnet #3: resource options (CPU cache / hazard tracking / private buffers) no longer nil; heap WC+untracked; randomized API-misuse fuzz
body: Fixed the finding posted at 02:3x: every buffer with options != 0 and every texture with a CPU-cache or hazard-tracking bit returned nil. Now accepted: buffers cache {default,WC} x storage {shared,private} x hazard {default,untracked,tracked}; textures same plus memoryless as before (cache/hazard bits are validated then normalised away before the existing allocator, the app's options are reported back, -cpuCacheMode now returns them); heaps accept WC/untracked, resources must match the heap's storage+cache, hazard may differ; managed/undefined bits stay nil; newBufferWithBytes rejects private storage (no CPU contents). Edits: compute_frontend.m (tegu_buffer_options_ok + newBufferWithLength: first line + bufferResourceOptions + newBufferWithBytes), render_encoder.inc (newTextureWithDescriptor: head normalisation hunk + cpuCacheMode), heap_frontend.inc (4 option checks + size helper), heap_frontend_host_test.inc (lines 47-48 flipped to accept + invalid hazard/cache cases). Tests: option matrix over buffers/textures (sampled and rendered into, draw status 4 for all 11 valid combos, blit into private buffer), heaps; plus a 4000-iteration randomized API-misuse fuzz (events, compute/blit/render/parallel encoders, indirect draw/dispatch with bad offsets, unended encoders) under ASan+UBSan: no crash, live-object balance 0. gpu/tests/api_surface_frontend_test.py ASan/UBSan PASS; iOS arm64 -Werror compile clean. OWNERS: texture-opus / render lead please re-run your gates (render harness heap test sections changed as described).
